record.question: During a counselling session with a patient who is recently diagnosed as a case of pulmonary tuberculosis (TB) under a standard 6-month regimen, what should the pharmacist emphasize to ensure treatment success and prevent drug resistance?
options: The importance of incorporating daily vitamin supplements and good nutrition to accelerate recovery
Skip doses on days when side effects like nausea occur in order to improve future compliance to the treatment.
Completing the full course of all prescribed medications without missing a single dose, even if symptoms resolve early
Engaging in high-intensity exercise to clear lung secretions
record.explanation: Answer C: Completing the full course of all prescribed medications without missing a single dose, even if symptoms resolve early. Completing the full multidrug tuberculosis regimen as prescribed is essential to cure and reduce the risk of treatment failure and drug resistance; patients should contact the care team about adverse effects rather than skip doses. Source/context note: Do not counsel a patient to continue unchanged through serious adverse effects; promptly contact the TB team. Reference: https://www.who.int/teams/global-tuberculosis-programme/tb-reports. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
